submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at 30.5 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.045% among all three candidate algorithms across the allowed threshold range (20-60 GeV). This represents a significant 19.045 percentage point improvement over Algorithm-L1's best efficiency (74.134% at 30 GeV) and an 7.99 percentage point improvement over Algorithm-L3's best efficiency (85.055% at 30 GeV). The fine-tuned threshold of 30.5 GeV was determined through refined scanning around the initial optimal value of 30 GeV, yielding an additional 1.461 percentage point efficiency gain. All constraints are satisfied: Algorithm-L2 is one of the three candidates specified in candidate_specs.md, it is FPGA-compatible and deployable in Level-1 trigger hardware, the threshold is within the 20-60 GeV range, and the algorithm operates within the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate.
